speak.label: Speaking
speak.title: Real conversations with Hablena
speak.text: Order coffee, nail a job interview, argue about football. Spoken scenes at exactly your level, with instant feedback on every sentence.

write.label: Writing
write.title: Corrected and explained
write.explain: A past location uses estar in the preterite. “Soy” is present-tense ser.

grammar.label: Grammar
grammar.title: Finally makes sense
grammar.ser: who or what something is. Soy ingeniero.
grammar.estar: how or where it is right now. Estoy cansado.

path.title: From hola to fluent.
path.text: Built on the official European CEFR levels, so you always know exactly where you stand. Ready for the DELE exam when you are.

levels.name: Beginner
levels.text: Introduce yourself, order food, find your way.

levels.name: Elementary
levels.text: Talk about your day, your past and your plans.

levels.name: Intermediate
levels.text: Handle travel, work and everyday life with ease.

levels.name: Upper intermediate
levels.text: Follow series and news, debate your opinion.

tutor.text: Hablena talks with you about your day, your work and your plans. She explains every mistake in your language and keeps track of what you need to practise next.

points.title: Speaks at your level
points.text: Slow and simple at A1, natural and fast at C1. Hablena adapts with every sentence you say.

points.title: Explains in your language
points.text: Every correction comes in English or German, with the reason behind it, not just the right answer.

points.title: Remembers what you need
points.text: Words and structures you struggle with come back in later conversations, until they stick.
